# AWS Secrets Manager

Update after Terraform apply. Secret path: `resido/<env>/<name>` (`dev` or `prod`)

## Auto-generated by Terraform (no manual step)

- `jwt-secret`
- `jwt-refresh-secret`
- `internal-service-secret`
- `media-worker-secret`

## You must provide

- `cors-origins`
- `msg91-auth-key`
- `msg91-template-id`
- `msg91-api-key`
- `aws-access-key-id`
- `aws-secret-access-key`
- `aws-s3-access-key`
- `aws-s3-secret-key`
- `aws-s3-endpoint`
- `aws-s3-bucket-name`
- `cloudflare-r2-public-url`
- `firebase-service-account-json`
